card.name: Partway through names and split symbols
card.fires_on: Fires on the first piece of a name or acronym that is split into parts, such as a surname (Sl-, S-) or an acronym (IRA, NCTM). Also fires on broken-up special characters such as the garbled bytes after a drug name.

modes.label: Split surnames
modes.description: First piece of a person's surname in author, editor or investigator credits.
modes.example: Principal Investigator: William H<< Sl>>attery, MD

modes.label: Acronyms and brand names
modes.description: Inside an organization acronym or brand name split into pieces.

modes.label: Garbled characters
modes.description: Broken bytes of a symbol, such as a dash or Greek letter, after a drug term.

card.writes: It promotes 'by' and its Chinese and Indonesian equivalents, suggesting an upcoming agent such as 'by' or 'made by'.
card.plain: It marks the middle of a split-up name or garbled symbol, where text like 'by' might come next.
